label: Mission
description: Which mission from the board the squad rides out on. The commander picks the mission; the squad votes for or against that pick, weighing how dangerous it is and whether it is a command order.

values.for: {name} backs the run: it fits what she values ({axis}).
values.against: {name} objects to the run: it cuts against what she values ({axis}).

trust.against: {name} does not trust the commander's call.

stance.for: {name} goes along: crossing the commander costs too much.
stance.against: {name} sees no reason to go along with the commander.

demand.for: {name} votes yes, though her own demand is still open.
demand.against: {name} is still waiting on her own demand and says no.

affected.for: {name} sees no harm to herself in this run.
affected.against: {name} is the one this run lands on.

label: Base upgrade
description: Which facility the base spends its credits and Plyx on next. The commander picks the upgrade; the squad votes for or against that pick.

values.for: {name} wants the upgrade: it fits what she values ({axis}).
values.against: {name} would spend the money elsewhere: it cuts against what she values ({axis}).

trust.against: {name} does not trust the commander's call.

stance.for: {name} goes along: crossing the commander costs too much.
stance.against: {name} sees no reason to go along with the commander.

demand.for: {name} votes yes, though her own demand is still open.
demand.against: {name} is still waiting on her own demand and says no.

affected.for: {name} expects to gain from the upgrade.
affected.against: {name} expects to lose out on the upgrade.

label: Punishment
description: Whether the commander punishes a soldier with a measure up to the brig. The squad votes for or against that punishment, and the soldier it is aimed at always votes against it.

trust.against: {name} does not trust the commander's call.

stance.for: {name} goes along: crossing the commander costs too much.
stance.against: {name} sees no reason to go along with the commander.

demand.for: {name} votes yes, though her own demand is still open.
demand.against: {name} is still waiting on her own demand and says no.

affected.for: {name} does not see herself in the soldier's place.
affected.against: {name} sees herself in the soldier's place, or is that soldier.

label: Rations
description: How a shortage is shared out. The commander picks a ration mode; the squad votes for or against that pick.

values.for: {name} accepts the ration split: it fits what she values ({axis}).
values.against: {name} rejects the ration split: it cuts against what she values ({axis}).

trust.against: {name} does not trust the commander's call.

stance.for: {name} goes along: crossing the commander costs too much.
stance.against: {name} sees no reason to go along with the commander.

demand.for: {name} votes yes, though her own demand is still open.
demand.against: {name} is still waiting on her own demand and says no.

affected.for: {name} will not go hungry on this split.
affected.against: {name} will go hungrier on this split.

label: Blame
description: Who takes the blame when a decision the squad made fails and oversight punishes it. The commander picks to take the blame or to shift it; the squad votes for or against that pick.

values.for: {name} agrees on who answers for this ({axis}).
values.against: {name} disagrees on who answers for this ({axis}).

trust.against: {name} does not trust the commander's call.

stance.for: {name} goes along: crossing the commander costs too much.
stance.against: {name} sees no reason to go along with the commander.

demand.for: {name} votes yes, though her own demand is still open.
demand.against: {name} is still waiting on her own demand and says no.

affected.for: {name} is not the one who answers for this.
affected.against: {name} is the one who would answer for this.
